description: Unit tests for the ClusterOptionsValidator class, verifying configuration validation logic for ClusterOptions objects in Orleans.

classes.name: ClusterOptionsValidatorTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for validating the ClusterOptions validation logic in Orleans.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithValidOptions_ShouldNotThrow
methods.description: Tests that valid ClusterOptions do not trigger validation errors.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithDefaultValues_ShouldNotThrow
methods.description: Tests that default ClusterOptions do not trigger validation errors.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithNullClusterId_ShouldThrowOrleansConfigurationException
methods.description: Checks that null ClusterId throws a validation exception.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithEmptyClusterId_ShouldThrowOrleansConfigurationException
methods.description: Checks that empty ClusterId throws a validation exception.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithWhitespaceClusterId_ShouldThrowOrleansConfigurationException
methods.description: Checks that whitespace ClusterId throws a validation exception.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithNullServiceId_ShouldThrowOrleansConfigurationException
methods.description: Checks that null ServiceId throws a validation exception.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithEmptyServiceId_ShouldThrowOrleansConfigurationException
methods.description: Checks that empty ServiceId throws a validation exception.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithWhitespaceServiceId_ShouldThrowOrleansConfigurationException
methods.description: Checks that whitespace ServiceId throws a validation exception.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithBothIdsInvalid_ShouldThrowForClusterId
methods.description: Verifies that invalid (empty) ClusterId is validated first.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration_WithVariousValidFormats_ShouldNotThrow
methods.description: Tests that various valid formats for ClusterId and ServiceId do not throw validation errors.

methods.name: ClusterOptions_DefaultClusterId_ShouldBeDefault
methods.description: Verifies default value for ClusterId in ClusterOptions.

methods.name: ClusterOptions_DefaultServiceId_ShouldBeDefault
methods.description: Verifies default value for ServiceId in ClusterOptions.
